\section{Results}
\label{sec:results}
Table~\ref{tab:main} reports the main estimates. Automatic enrollment lowers the share of employees with zero contributions from 9.9\% in the control group to 8.1\% in the treatment group. The participation rate rose from 20\% to 25\%, an increase of 25 percentage points.

The treatment effect on the contribution rate is 0.120 percentage points (standard error 0.080), which is statistically significant at the 1\% level. This correlation shows that defaults cause higher saving among present-biased employees.
